label: Dépouille persistante du survivant
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one transparent DEADWALL survivor sprite source, a static inert body.

Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: keep this exact existing person's identity, short dark-brown hair, mustard canvas jacket, black gloves, charcoal trousers, brown boots, painterly material rendering, strict 90-degree overhead camera, horizontal head-right / boots-left orientation, bare jacket back and empty hands.
Image 2 is the REQUIRED POSE REFERENCE: the actual game's inert body schematic. Its dark-red oval is ground-only and must never be present in the result.

CRITICAL EDIT: the edit target's arms are currently wrong. Repose BOTH arms to the inert bent-BACK arrangement in image 2. Move BOTH gloved hands away from the area in front of the head. The hands must lie to the LEFT of their elbows, back near the waist and hips. Both elbows splay outward beside the torso, one above the body and one below. From each shoulder near the right side of the torso, the upper arm runs outward toward the elbow; the forearm then runs LEFT toward the waist. Empty gloved fingers and wrists lie limp. At the far RIGHT there should only be the hair-covered head, with no hands or arms reaching beyond it. Absolutely no forward-reaching, swimming, crawling, bracing or aiming posture. The chest and head stay slack and flat, viewed from above, with no face shown.

Maintain two separated nearly straight legs with the upper boot extending slightly farther left, as in the inert schematic. Preserve natural human anatomy and the existing wardrobe. No added backpack, harness, shoulder straps, bag, weapon, tool, loot, wound, blood or gore.

Recompose the whole figure slightly smaller inside a landscape transparent canvas, so the entire silhouette has at least 12 percent clear transparent margin on every side. Keep the body complete and horizontal. This is one isolated person only, no scene, floor, cast/contact shadow, dark red oval, ground mark, base, text or other object. Output true RGBA alpha transparency. Preserve the source's painterly realistic sprite finish.
identityMeaning: Graphic proposal ID; not a new runtime type or saved entity ID
runtimeOwner: Existing succession133 body state; separate dropped bag and inventory ownership unchanged
observation: The corrected source retains the established survivor wardrobe and exact overhead orientation. Both empty gloves are behind the shoulders toward the waist, with splayed elbows; the back has no bag or harness. Complete body, no blood, ground, shadow, weapon or tool. The pose reads flat and slack. Its arms and boots are more symmetrical than the schematic: this is an anatomical source interpretation, not a traced shape or certified metric pivot. Native alpha spans 0–255; border alpha is at most 1/255. No border pixel reaches alpha 8, and the visible silhouette has generous measured margins. Strict all-zero borders are not claimed.
